locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

occurrenceStatus.description: Occurrence status always recorded as present for each record.

elevation.description: Elevation data is missing for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy data is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth measurement not recorded for any occurrence.

speciesKey.description: Unique identifier for Rusa timorensis occurrence records.

license.description: Creative Commons licensing for records, CC BY‑NC 4.0, CC BY 4.0, CC0 1.0.
